overall_goal: Prepare and arrange twisted cheese straws on baking trays.

goals.description: Retrieve a baking tray from the cupboard.
goals.rationale: The person opens the cupboard and takes out a baking tray to use for the cheese straws.

goals.description: Store the flour away in the cupboard.
goals.rationale: The person seals the bag of flour, places it in a Tupperware container, and puts it back into the cupboard.

goals.description: Clear items from the countertop to make space.
goals.rationale: The person moves a mixing bowl, grater, sponge, and scissors out of the way to clear the workspace.

goals.description: Twist and place the first batch of cheese straws on the tray.
goals.rationale: The person repeatedly picks up cheese straws, twists them, and places them onto the baking tray.

goals.description: Twist and place the second batch of cheese straws on the tray.
goals.rationale: The person continues to pick up, twist, and arrange more cheese straws on the baking tray.

goals.description: Twist and place the third batch of cheese straws on the tray.
goals.rationale: The person twists and places another set of cheese straws, separating any that are stuck together.

goals.description: Get a second baking tray and start placing twisted cheese straws on it.
goals.rationale: The person moves the first tray, retrieves a second baking tray, and begins twisting and placing cheese straws on it.

goals.description: Twist and place the fifth batch of cheese straws on the second tray.
goals.rationale: The person continues twisting cheese straws, separating stuck ones, and arranging them on the second baking tray.

goals.description: Twist and place the sixth batch of cheese straws on the second tray.
goals.rationale: The person twists and places more cheese straws onto the second baking tray, ensuring they do not unravel.

goals.description: Twist and place the final batch of cheese straws and adjust their spacing.
goals.rationale: The person finishes twisting the remaining cheese straws and adjusts their positions on the tray to ensure even spacing for baking.
